import urllib.request
url = 'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3496185/pdf/nihms406734.pdf'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'curl/8.0'})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        data = r.read()
        print(f'Status: {r.status}, Length: {len(data)}, Type: {r.headers.get("Content-Type")}')
        if data[:4] == b'%PDF':
            with open('tasks/t0078_bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp/assets/paper/10.1016_j.neuron.2012.08.041/files/rivlin-etzion_2012_directional-preference-reversal.pdf', 'wb') as f:
                f.write(data)
            print('Saved as PDF')
        else:
            print(f'First 200 bytes: {data[:200]!r}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
